rules.name: cs-20-cash-rows-legacy-vs-new-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT client_code, currency, cob_date, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_out, transfers_in, interest_charges, closing_balance FROM dbsystemuat.client_cash_account_balance_table_cfs WHERE cob_date = :settleDate

SELECT c.client_code, c.currency, c.cob_date, c.opening_balance, c.expired_or_liquidated_cash, c.premium_paid_or_recd, c.commission, c.transfers_out, c.transfers_in, c.interest_charges, c.closing_balance FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.cob_date = :settleDate
SELECT client_code, currency, threshold, independant_amount, final_threshold, min_trnsfr_amt, double_currency, provision FROM dbsystemuat.client_threshold_master_table_cfs

SELECT t.client_code, t.currency, t.threshold, t.independant_amount, t.final_threshold, t.min_trnsfr_amt, t.double_currency, t.provision FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND t.business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT 'cash' AS src, client_code, currency, cob_date, premium_paid_or_recd, closing_balance, opening_balance FROM dbsystemuat.client_cash_account_balance_table_cfs WHERE client_code IN ('UNF', 'ORM') AND cob_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-12' ORDER BY client_code, cob_date, currency
